overview: The paper proposes ENVIRONMENT TUNING, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn LLM agents under extreme data scarcity, which uses a structured curriculum, actionable environment augmentation (pedagogical hints), and fine-grained progress rewards to enable stable exploration and robust generalization without expert demonstrations.

modules.name: Multi-Turn Tool-Use Simulation Environment
modules.description: Manages the stateful execution of tool calls and environment transitions for specific domains (e.g., Travel, File System), maintaining the environment state and providing standard diagnostic error feedback for failed actions.

modules.name: Actionable Environment Augmentation Pipeline
modules.description: Implements a generator-judge workflow to produce pedagogical hints for failed actions. It analyzes error trajectories to suggest prerequisite steps or clarify constraints, and validates the augmented feedback to prevent solution leakage before integrating it into the environment.

modules.name: Fine-Grained Reward Function Module
modules.description: Calculates turn-level rewards for training, including syntactic/format rewards, tool call validity rewards, and a progress reward based on the alignment of the resulting environment state and execution results with ground truth.

modules.name: Structured Curriculum Manager
modules.description: Orchestrates the four-stage training progression, transitioning between stages based on validation accuracy plateaus and gradient norm stability. It controls the active dataset split, reward function configuration, and whether environment augmentation is enabled.

modules.name: Dataset Partitioner and Loader
modules.description: Loads benchmark datasets and partitions them into specific subsets (Base, Missing Functions, Missing Parameters, Long Context) corresponding to the requirements of different curriculum stages, managing the transition of training data availability.

modules.name: GRPO Reinforcement Learning Optimizer
modules.description: Implements the Group-Relative Policy Optimization algorithm with specific enhancements for stability, including decoupled clipping mechanisms for the probability ratio and a KL divergence penalty to regularize the policy against the reference model.

modules.name: Agent-Environment Rollout Executor
modules.description: Handles the interaction loop between the LLM agent and the environment, generating trajectories (observations, actions, tool calls) by processing the agent's outputs and feeding back environment observations or augmented error messages.

modules.name: Validation and Checkpoint Transition Logic
modules.description: Monitors training dynamics, specifically tracking validation accuracy convergence and gradient norm stability, to determine the optimal timing for advancing to the next curriculum stage and saving model checkpoints.

modules.name: Comprehensive Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Executes in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluation protocols across multiple benchmarks (e.g., BFCL V3/V4, Tau2-bench, ACEBench), computing success rates for various sub-tasks like Web Search and Memory retrieval.

modules.name: Experiment Orchestrator and Logger
modules.description: Manages the end-to-end experimental workflow, coordinating the curriculum manager, rollout executor, and optimizer, while logging training dynamics (reward curves, entropy, gradient norms) and aggregating results for analysis.
